messages:
nina: Quick sync after yesterday's outage. We need final wording and owners for customer follow-ups: what goes on status page vs what we provide on request. Sketch below.

rob: agree. keep public bits short. legal wants neutral phrasing; ops wants templated snippets.

nina: Proposed tiers: (A) Public summary -> auto within 24h (one paragraph). (B) Technical addendum -> default within 72h if >1hr or >5% impact. (C) Full RCA package -> on request or P0. Redact customer PII.

mano: For recurring incidents, define thresholds and wording. Suggest: >=2 similar incidents in 30 days OR >=3 in 90 days => mark "recurring" and include owner + ETA in addendum.

clare: wording example for public: "Service disruption affecting <product>. Restored at <time>. We're investigating and will post more details." No blame, no internal refs.

nina: Action list: 1) clare post public summary (owner: clare, due_ts: 2423460000) 2) mano + eng lead draft addendum (owner: mano, due_ts: 2423623800) 3) rob own intake for full-package requests + approvals (owner: rob, due_ts: 2423700000) 4) nina add templates to incidents repo (owner: nina, due_ts: 2423462000)

incident-bot: I'll add a nightly job to check incident similarity tags and notify when recurrence thresholds hit. Need eng-ml scoring endpoint.

mano: I'll sync with eng-ml tomorrow to define signature.

clare: Posting public summary now and will add link.

incident-bot: Public summary posted to status page at 2423459800 (https://status.redwood.example/incident/2423456789)

nina: Thanks all. I'll convert these to the SOP and create the follow-up tracker.
